maya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock the MVP shape for a model discovery endpoint this sprint. Customers asking: can the model call tools? does it stream? token limits?

devon (Eng): +1 to machine-readable. We keep docs human-readable too but product SDKs need a canonical shape.

simon (ML Eng): Suggested minimal payload: booleans for streaming/function calling, array of supported tool identifiers, and token limits. Also include `response_structure_schema_url` instead of embedding schema for v1. Example:

```json
{
  \"model_id\": \"redwood-13b-v1\",
  \"supports_streaming\": true,
  \"supports_functions\": true,
  \"supported_tools\": [\"search\", \"finance-sdk\"],
  \"max_context_tokens\": 32768,
  \"max_generation_tokens\": 4096,
  \"recommended_batch_size\": 8,
  \"response_structure_schema_url\": \"https://docs.redwood.ai/schemas/rich-response-v1.json\"
}
```

lia (Product): Launch criteria proposal: (1) endpoint spec stable and documented, (2) SDKs map fields into client feature flags, (3) 2 pilot customers integrated and no regressions for streaming, (4) console shows capability toggles per model.

ashok (Infra): Runtime notes — `recommended_batch_size` and `supports_streaming` affect routing/queueing. If we expose `kv_cache_hint` later, it\'ll need runtime metrics. For MVP we should avoid runtime-only knobs.

maya (PM): Customer-driven asks prioritized: payments rerank + function-calling for external ledger => high priority. Embeddings-only models should return `supports_functions:false` and `embedding_dimensions` field.

devon (Eng): Versioning: expose `discovery_version` int. v1 = simple flags + urls. v2 can add structured output schema in-band and detailed latency profiles.

simon (ML Eng): On token limits: keep separate `max_context_tokens` vs `max_generation_tokens` and add `context_window_types` list (e.g., [\"tokens\",\"chars\"])? Probably overkill; leave as tokens for now.

maya (PM): Trade-offs: Smaller surface = faster rollout but more customer integration pain. Bigger surface = more runtime work. Recommend MVP = flags + tool list + token limits + schema URL.

lia (Product): Decision tickbox: MVP shape = flags + tools + token limits + schema URL. SDK mappings + console UI = must-have for GA.

rwood-bot: New doc uploaded: https://internal.redwood/s/notes/discovery-api-draft (maya).

maya (PM): Action items: I will draft the spec PR by EOD Fri. @simon add sample JSON generator from model metadata. @devon give infra estimate by Mon. :thumbsup:
